kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the source facts (4 patterns, 4 traps, 3 pivots).
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the two definitions and the two figures only; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The two-axes reading protocol (AXIS 1 THE CEILING — Emax on the Y, ↑ y-value = ↑ Emax = ↑ efficacy, partial agonists plateau lower; AXIS 2 THE ADDRESS — EC50 on the X, left shifting = ↓ EC50 = ↑ potency = ↓ drug needed; then REFUSE TO CROSS THE AXES) plus the independence grid (the KYP 2×2 of high/low potency × high/low efficacy, every cell a real drug behavior) — KYP's synthesis of the page's two symmetric definitions into one figure protocol.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the two definitions and the two figures separately and never states the read-order protocol or draws the 2×2 of possible drug behaviors; the protocol, the grid, and the four axis-error distractor archetypes are KYP's design.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea + blocks[2] the steps block + the registry visual's Panels 3-4 + pivots

kypExtensions.summary: The four KYP mnemonics (EFFICACY IS THE CEILING; POTENCY IS THE ADDRESS / LEFT SHIFT, LESS DRUG / TALL DOESN'T MEAN CHEAP, AND CHEAP DOESN'T MEAN TALL / PARTIAL PLATEAUS LOWER) — no mnemonic prints on the page.
kypExtensions.rationale: No mnemonic prints anywhere on book 232 (text census; the VLM confirm attempt failed 401 on environment credentials, and the text layer carries no margin notes); the four codes are KYP's design.

kypExtensions.summary: The three-curve figure miniCase (curves 1 and 2 fusing the RELATIVE POTENCY figure — same 100% ceiling, curve 1 ten-fold left; curve 3 fusing the RELATIVE EFFICACY figure — 50% plateau at curve 1's exact EC50, the partial agonist) with the four axis-error distractors (position read as height; the more-drug-stronger fallacy; potency ranked by plateau; the plateau misread as an unfinished dose range) — a KYP-authored fusion of the page's two figures into one question.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid prints the two figures separately and never asks the learner to read both axes off one fused figure or to resist the cross-axis substitutions; the vignette, the four distractors, and the reasoning are KYP's design.

notes: Census (pdfimages): ZERO raster images on pdf 254 / book 232 — pure text plus the TWO VECTOR dose-response figures (RELATIVE EFFICACY: % Maximal effect 0-100 vs Log (drug dose), Drug A plateauing at Emax 100 and Drug B at Emax 50 with the Δ Efficacy bracket between the plateaus; RELATIVE POTENCY: Drug A left-shifted of Drug B at the SAME maximal effect, with the Δ Potency bracket, two EC50 markers, and the EC = Effective concentration note).
